newsitem.title: USA: U.S. MTBE weakens as buyers wait until last minute.
newsitem.headline: U.S. MTBE weakens as buyers wait until last minute.

text.p: U.S. spot MTBE prices weakened on Tuesday in very slow trade as buyers held back in anticipation of weaker values, players said.
"Buyers are waiting until the last minute," said a U.S. Gulf trader. "The backwardation is pretty steep in September, in the 87.00 cent range, and if that is to believed you don't want to buy now."
No deals were heard done either Monday or so far today. A ship, however, was loaded over the weekend in the U.S. Gulf for delivery into the Harbor.
Another ship was heard loading for the West Coast, but it was unclear if all the product necessary had been bought, traders said.
In the Gulf, spot Houston MTBE was pegged about a half cent weaker at 91.00/91.50 cents. In New York Harbor, spot MTBE shed about two cents since Friday to 95.50/96.50 cents, notionally.
Despite the decline, MTBE's value for blending to make reformulated gasoline remains at a fairly strong 6.00 cents a gallon.
-- Laney Salisbury, New York Energy Desk +1 212 859 1631--
